title: Imagined speech EEG dataset — vowels condition (Nguyen et al. 2017)
description: Preprocessed 64-channel EEG recordings from 8 healthy participants performing imagined speech of three vowel phonemes (a, i, u) in response to auditory and visual cues. The dataset was re-packaged in BIDS format from the MOABB collection and supports decoding of imagined speech with Riemannian manifold features and relevance vector machine classification.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a BrainProducts ActiCHamp system (64 channels: 60 EEG, 4 EOG) at 256 Hz using a 10-20 montage. Participants imagined speaking vowels following auditory beeps at 1 s intervals with visual cues. Preprocessing comprised 8-70 Hz Butterworth bandpass filtering, a 60 Hz notch filter, and adaptive EOG artifact removal. Features were extracted using Riemannian tangent space mapping with CSP spatial filtering across mu, beta and gamma bands.
